title: Passenger
description: Make it to the gate on time. How hard can it be? Take on the role of a travelling consultant and navigate airports to catch your flight to the next gig, all while making your meetings and keeping your life and career in order.

image.alt: A stylized airport terminal with a moving walkway, seating, departure displays, and a plane visible through large windows.

title: Agent
description: Agent is a narrative-driven micro-simulation where you play as the last human check-in agent at a small international airport. As automation takes over, you’ll navigate quirky requests, shifting policies, and the quiet tension of a world moving on without you while making connections like no machine could ever make.

image.alt: A stylized airport wayfinding sign reading Agent, with a tentative title note below and check-in signs in the background.
